remarks: Stunning modern farmhouse colonial on sought after Gault Park Drive. This enclave of cul-de-sacs is known for its proximity to everything the town of Westport has to offer. Minutes to town, minutes to the train and minutes to the beach. All from this fabulous neighborhood of active homeowners riding bikes and walking the quiet streets. Built in 2014, but customized in the past few years with an amazing office, mudroom and bath, family room with beams, built ins and a stunning gas fireplace. Constructed with an open concept that lends to an easy flow of indoor and outdoor living, which is also great for entertaining. The primary bedroom suite sits privately on the second level away from the other 3 bedrooms separated by an enormous second level family space with multiple uses. The fifth bedroom with its own full bath is on the main level. The expansive lawn rolls to the home that is perfectly sited on the property to enable multiple pool sites and privacy should someone wish to add a pool. Not often does a home and property of this caliber in a prime location come to market in Westport. Now's the time to make this home your own.
